before: Backspace and Delete at an inline content control's edge took one character, across a drawn tag into or out of the control, so no key could remove a text control; in a control showing its prompt they took letters of the prompt.
after: With tags drawn, a key whose neighbour in the caret's slot is a tag selects that control whole (contentControlChrome.selectedIds, data-selected on its chrome) and the next press, the word keys or cut removes it with removeContentControl keepContent false. With tags drawn, a key in a control showing its prompt removes it at once. Without drawn tags every key keeps the previous behaviour.
reason: The selected control is surface state and never enters shared updates. The removal is the existing removeContentControl op, which the journal already replicates.
